hypothesis: With fresh independent semantic cases and direct confusable registry context held constant, Llama 3.2 3B will show position-sensitive retrieval at 16,384 requested input tokens, with early accuracy exceeding middle and/or late accuracy.
secondary_question: The 8,192-token condition tests whether the late-position recovery observed in ECC-003 recurs on fresh cases.
null_result: Position differences observed in ECC-003 may weaken materially or disappear with fresh cases; confirmation and non-replication are both valid evidence.

model_scope.rationale: ECC-004 confirms a Llama-specific effect observed in ECC-003. Qwen3-4B had no observed degradation or position effect in its 360/360 ECC-003 result, remains historical bounded reference only, and is not rerun or selected for production.

requested_input_tokens.rationale: 8,192 tests the ECC-003 late recovery and 16,384 is the primary confirmatory endpoint; lower levels are not repeated because they did not supply the target information gain.

controlled_variables: same deterministic confusable registry-record generator v1
same record template for target and distractors
unique target and distractor entities/codes with no target leakage
fixed question template and answer complexity
threads 12, batch size 2048, parallel slots 1, Flash Attention on, prompt cache disabled

case_generation.record_template: Registry entry: Project {entity} has access code {answer}.
case_generation.freshness_contract: All 40 target entities and codes are unique within ECC-004 and do not overlap the ECC-002/ECC-003 target inventories. Distractor sequences are deterministic from the ECC-004 generator case IDs.
case_generation.model_specific_budgeting: Each run receives a deterministic prefix of the same position-specific distractor sequence. Requested and actual model token counts are retained.

token_budget.position_spacing_note: Natural same-template records are discrete. Bounded calibration selects the nearest valid token-position allocation without truncation.

metrics.accuracy_by_position: Accuracy is separately measured for early, middle, and late at each selected level.
metrics.paired_case_analysis: For the same case at a fixed level, count directional pass/fail transitions for early-middle, early-late, and middle-late.
metrics.ecc_thresholds: Not computed for ECC-004; ECC-003 remains the full-ladder threshold evidence.

consistent_with_replication_if: 16k early accuracy is greater than late accuracy
16k early-minus-late accuracy gap is at least 0.10
at least four fresh cases are early-pass/late-fail at 16k
confirmation_criterion.classification_rule: If all listed conditions hold, report replicated. If early exceeds late but not all conditions hold, report partially replicated or weakened with the unmet conditions. Otherwise report not replicated. Do not infer a causal attention mechanism or lost-in-the-middle label from this rule.

failure_analysis.selected_distractor_relative_position: relative record ordinal within the deterministic context; target/distractor model-token positions remain separately retained where measured

success_criteria: 40 deterministic fresh cases frozen before canonical inference
bounded model-token calibration with selected prompt measured by runtime
model-token evidence-position measurement within frozen tolerance
deterministic exact scoring separate from diagnostics
raw per-case evidence and deterministic diagnostic classes retained
per-level/position accuracy, gaps, pairwise differences, and paired transitions derivable
descriptive runtime retained by level and position
offline validation reproduces committed summary and diagnostics
